title: On Eating the last of the winter stores
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：eat　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eat 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the doctor ① ate the last of the winter stores without a word of thanks, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② eats the last of the winter stores at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ eat the last of the winter stores at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ eaten the last of the winter stores before — a line in the chart for January 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Eating the last of the winter stores without a word of thanks, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ eat into the savings every month at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Eat into the savings every month at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ eats into the savings every month without a word of thanks every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ ate the last of the winter stores again when nobody else would.

⑩ To eat the last of the winter stores, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody eats the last of the winter stores at once again and somebody must eat the last of the winter stores without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 吃（一般过去式 ate the last of the winter stores：1990 年大夫头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 吃（一般现在 eats the last of the winter stores：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 吃（不定式 to eat the last of the winter stores：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 吃（过去完成时 had eaten the last of the winter stores：1984 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 吃（动名词 eating the last of the winter stores 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 吃掉（eat into the savings every month：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去吃掉月月都要吃掉一点积蓄）
G. v. 吃掉（eat into the savings every month：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 吃（后段两处：新来的病人照例 eats into the savings every month，而母亲又一次 ate the last of the winter stores）

eat 意为“吃”，自那以后大夫二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 eats。
eat 意为“吃”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯吃吃掉冬储的最后一点”，此处为不定式 to eat the last of the winter stores。
eat 意为“吃”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人吃过，故用过去完成时 had eaten。

eat 意为“吃掉”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去吃掉月月都要吃掉一点积蓄”，should ever 之后用原形 eat into the savings every month。
eat 意为“吃掉”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻吃掉月月都要吃掉一点积蓄（eat into the savings every month at once），以后再也不要提起。
eat 意为“吃”，新来的病人每个星期都照例吃掉月月都要吃掉一点积蓄，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 eats。
eat 意为“吃”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢吃吃掉冬储的最后一点，用一般过去式 ate 叙述。
eat 意为“吃”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要吃吃掉冬储的最后一点，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 eat 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the doctor ate the last of the winter stores without a word of thanks, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor eats the last of the winter stores at once whenever the clinic asks.
Eating the last of the winter stores without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever eat into the savings every month at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new patient from the next clinic eats into the savings every month without a word of thanks every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother ate the last of the winter stores again, and the clinic remembered that half.
